subject: domain: add resolve lock logic for mvcc get key loading schema diff (#48330)
summary: Adds `Helper.GetMvccByEncodedKeyWithTS` in `pkg/store/helper` to synchronously resolve encountered locks (via client-go `LockResolver.ResolveLocksWithOpts`) when fetching MVCC for the schema-diff key, and wires Domain to pass `startTS` so schema-diff commit TS can be obtained even if the key is temporarily locked. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the store-side lock-resolution/backoff logic or its expected usage for schema-diff MVCC reads.
